card.name: The word forever after a verb
card.fires_on: The word "forever" (or " forever") right after a verb or auxiliary such as was, be, and, will, or going. It is most striking before changed, scarred, lost, or banished.

modes.label: Before a change or loss
modes.description: "forever" sits between an auxiliary and a past participle describing a lasting change or loss.
modes.example: Safari Hunting in East Africa was<< forever>> changed by the masterly blueprint of Brian

modes.label: After a verb, ending a phrase
modes.description: "forever" closes a clause to mean endlessly or without end.
modes.example: it will reach a terminal velocity in the granular material and keep going<< forever>>.

card.plain: It fires on the word "forever" when it describes something permanently changed, lost, or continuing without end.
